limits: This verifier executes no released binary, Cargo command, test or Cloud consumer.

Executable bytes are omitted from the evidence archive. Recorded per-command before/after identities and final sizes/modes match frozen pins and download receipts; executable bytes cannot be independently rehashed here.

Original file modes are verified from outer tar headers because safe extraction normalizes local modes. Directory modes are recorded fixture assertions; outer tar contains no directories to independently recheck their original metadata.

Per-refusal unchanged-tree assertions are bound by exact fixture source and completed test/transcript. Retained pre/post snapshots independently match; there is no separate filesystem snapshot after every individual refusal.
Provenance verification checks writer JSON bytes against actual package archives only, not installed_from or Cloud consumption.
The four routine cases and full 6974-file source-to-Git comparison are outside this independent package-only audit and remain root responsibilities.
No Store trust/signature, updater install, complete product folder set, physical output or power-loss qualification is established.
